settings.title: Glacier West is a Canadian design-build contractor specializing in cold storage, food processing, and complex industrial construction.

settings.editor: With over 30 years of experience and 3+ million square feet of completed food processing and cold storage facilities, we understand the technical requirements behind regulated, high-performance environments.

From renovations and expansions to full-scale greenfield construction, our team delivers integrated construction solutions designed around compliance, efficiency, and the way your facility needs to operate.
To simplify complex industrial construction by delivering specialized facilities that help our clients operate with confidence.
To set the benchmark for specialized industrial construction in Canada through trusted partnerships, technical excellence, and projects that create lasting value.
From new construction to expansions, upgrades and specialized conversions, we create spaces that support your operation today and adapt for what’s next.
Planning, engineering and construction under one coordinated team, tailored around how your facility needs to operate — from workflow and layout to building systems and long-term performance.
Early planning around your operation — workflow, layout, approvals and budget.
Building systems and compliance engineered alongside construction, not after it.
One team carries the project through to a facility built for long-term performance.

From food processing plants to refrigerated distribution centres, Glacier West has delivered complex industrial projects across Canada with a focus on performance, compliance, and efficient execution.
